normal.interpretation: Silence demand control, not listening or emulator qualification; sample_frames are reported buffer sizes, not measured wall-clock periods.

limits: One normal run and historical disk data, not contemporaneous randomized performance A/B.
Normal adds SDL observation, different backend/buffer/callback cadence and later host conditions; slowdown cause is unisolated.
Phase boundaries are approximate; rates include intentional rests and gaps. Primary nominal240MHz and peripheral deadline clocks are distinct.
Exact producer-to-delivery reconstruction and zero scheduled DMA lateness do not qualify synthesis, mixer scheduling or physical output.
Observed callback elapsed time is not total instrumentation CPU overhead; no unobserved boost/thermal/scheduler condition is inferred.
No listening, repair, new execution or publication acceptance.

normal_phases.scope: Each phase includes notes and intended rests. Host phase-file polling/buffering delays are not sample-accurate. Event counters identify host-inserted samples;127values alone do not. Varying real prefix followed by inserted127 establishes a delivery discontinuity, not clean upstream synthesis or physical audibility.

release.purpose: Resumed sealed r02 normal-audio diagnostic: one 8-second control, then conditional 90-second-bound stock fixture; no prior arm ran

disk.capture_format: unsigned 8-bit mono, explicitly specified by FX-062 instrumentation; not SDL disk format

waveform.interpretation: Descriptive U8 statistics; neither distortion nor underruns inferred from values.

dma.interpretation: Emulated peripheral deadline lateness; not host callback latency or proof of audible corruption.

delivered_real_rate.window: post-first to post-last event; excludes first event's samples

production_rate.window: post-first to post-last event; excludes first event's samples

sequence_comparison.method: Producer order after exact oldest-prefix drops, real dequeues, then recorded missing-frame 127 tails.

interpretation_limits: Missing/capped events or PCM permit only a prefix comparison; summary completeness flags remain authoritative.
A byte equal to 127 is not itself an underrun; only event counter reconciliation identifies inserted silence.
Matching delivery to the producer does not prove the producer waveform, firmware timing or physical audio is correct.
Counters and waveform statistics do not establish audible distortion, causality, or human acceptance.
Guest seconds use the diagnostic's nominal 240MHz primary-cycle scale; host seconds remain separate.
